# Canva Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that works with Canva through the Canva Connect API (OAuth 2.0): list designs and folders, inspect a design, create designs, upload assets, and export to PNG/JPG/PDF/MP4 — exports run as async jobs you poll until done. Confirm before creating, uploading or exporting; tokens expire after ~4 hours and the credential flow handles refresh. No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
